sampling.method: shared seeded random held-out window order across four poles; stop each pole after 16 distinct strong windows; one uniform activation per sampled window
sampling.gpu_scheduling: normal-priority FIFO turn per model forward, with the project batch-memory slot

notes: Budgeted joint coverage sampling: four poles share the seeded random held-out window order of L34/N4070-, with each pole using its own contribution-id seed for uniform per-window selection. The 0.30 threshold and first-64-token exclusion match graph.coverage.draw; each pole stops after at least 16 distinct strong windows instead of oversampling 48. The final batch can contain extra qualifying windows; its batch size is recorded in methods.sampling. No label-based sample selection. Activations are the original float16 readings; the PR reports an additional bfloat16 check of these fixed positions. Marks judge the registered label without broadening it. Marked from the visible sampled context. Indented blank lines count as spaces immediately before a line break. Plain LF-only Python excerpts without visible trailing whitespace are false; padding elsewhere outside the excerpt was not inferred. One non-Python personal/contact excerpt was redacted, preserving its window, position, activation and mark.
